notes: Element IDs are read from the page labels; piece names and colours are inferred from the pictures and may be inexact, as there is no inventory page in the supplied pages.
The white piece under the ring 9551 in step 1 is not labelled, so I treated it as part of 4180469 or 9551.
Step 4 labels two 393726 pieces. I stacked them on 4233486 in order: 4233486, then 393726, then 393726. The images are low resolution.

Which pieces each plate or brick sits on is judged from the pictures. The attachment points of the skids (4259937), the canopy (4195869), the arch (4204624) and the engine pieces (436026, 434926) are best estimates.
The minifig is built on page 1 and sits in the cockpit in step 6. The manual does not say which studs it sits on, so I joined its legs to the base hull.
Only one 434926 is counted. A second black cylinder in step 6 could be 434926 or the 436026 sub-assembly, so the count is uncertain.
All stud connections are given as rigid, reversible by hand. Rotors, visor and head can rotate, so they are marked revolute.
